ctx.x: Yeah, but I mean you explain that.

Oh, yes. This was way before 52nd Street. In fact, this was like when we were first forming Earl Hines' band, when we hit Cleveland is when I bought this arrangement off of Tad, 'Sweet Georgia Brown.' And I didn't get to 52nd Street until 1942. This was like back in 1938.
I see. Well, let's name some more New York saxophone players.
